end.summary:
Practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Counted a triangle’s 3 sides and 3 corners.
Used a starting corner and counted around the shape back to the start.
Identified a rectangle from its 4 sides and 4 corners.
Explained that a triangle remains a triangle when turned or tilted; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting around shapes, starting at any corner and returning to it, and naming shapes from their sides and corners. Ayaan used the triangle’s three sides and corners correctly and explained that turning it does not change its shape. They mixed up the idea of where to start counting, but this was clarified later by counting around the shape back to the starting corner. At home, ask them to draw or find a triangle and rectangle, then count the sides and corners aloud, starting from different corners.
